Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner's initial hypothesis that Edison used the scientific method (Step 1) is a data fabrication that misinterprets the historical consensus of the "Edisonian" trial-and-error approach. This error creates an irrecoverable loop because all subsequent search instructions are biased toward finding non-existent confirmation of the scientific method, preventing the agents from correctly identifying the actual historical methodology.
